instagram.author: ryanmagin
instagram.body:
Video editing is becoming a commodity.

Not because content doesn’t matter.

Because distribution matters more than production now.

AI, clippers, cheap labor, infinite content creation… the game changed.

I’ve run a short form content agency for 5+ years and done millions in revenue helping creators and businesses grow through content.

And the biggest thing I’m seeing in 2026?

Most business owners are overinvesting in polish… and underinvesting in volume.

This video is my raw take on where content, video editing, and distribution are headed.

If you’re trying to grow a business, personal brand, or sell anything online… this matters.

Comment Pretty to watch the vid
Pretty videos are dead. Slow, creative, very pretty and aesthetic death right now, and I know all you video editors, everyone was like, "Oh, who's this guy hating video editors? Video editors are going to live forever because they're needed," yada, yada. First off, I'm not talking about Hollywood productions. But if I were a video editor for them, I'd probably be worried about that, too, because those are getting taken away by AI. And the fact of the matter is, it's not video editing that's dying. But what is dying is one, business owners, and people's willing to pay for that video to get edited and created and then put on the internet. Because that is where it's being consumed. That is dying.

tiktok.author: gadgetguycolin
tiktok.body:
Subscriptions are creeping into everything, even doorbells. A few weeks ago I asked what subscriptions people dislike most, and the clear winner was smart doorbells. And honestly, I agree — paying monthly just to use your own device doesn’t sit right with most people. The good news is there are solid alternatives that store footage locally instead of charging you every month. Same core features, no ongoing fees, and full control over your own data. Sometimes the smartest upgrade isn’t a new feature, it’s removing the subscription altogether. Comment “Security” and I’ll send you the link. #SmartDoorbell #HomeSecurity #SecurityCamera #SmartHomeTech #NoSubscription #StopSubscriptions #SubscriptionFree #OwnYourTech #TechTips #ConsumerTech #SmartTech
Ditch your ring subscription. A few weeks ago I did a call out on one of my stories about what your least favourite or most hated subscription was, and outstandingly, it was the ring subscription. I think you're right, having to subscribe to a doorbell is nonsense. Now there is ways around it, as I mentioned in that story. Um, the Netis doorbell. And actually the Netis security cameras in general. They've got those same smart features and they're inexpensive to purchase. But they use local storage on memory cards like this, and you can record and store for weeks depending on the size of memory card you use, and so there's zero subscription. So if you'd like more information on these, comment security below and I'll send you a link to all of them.
